findings_for_followup: middleware/authorize.js:74 reassigns the closed-over roles parameter, so an account role_preferences override persists for later requests on that route
authorizeService accepts any JWT signed with JWT_SECRET, acts as the EVOKE AUTOMATED NOTES user, and calls next twice when the token is missing
/v2/mfa/otp/validate-login issues a session from email and OTP without a password check (analyst finding, not re-verified)
BodyTrace and Twilio webhooks have no authentication or signature validation; Zoom signature check returns true when NODE_ENV is unset (config.isDevelopment)

CSP, input sanitizer and global rate limiting are commented out or absent in app.js; multer upload size limits not set except the account-document uploader (5 MiB, one file, PDF check; analyst finding at onboarding for the rest)
Production deploy on push to main runs no tests and has no manual gate; release PR from lf-uat to main gets no PR checks (conflicts with aisdlc production-writes-disabled default)
Pipeline writes the OIDC token to web-identity-token in the build context and .dockerignore does not exclude it (image contents not inspected)
quick_text_template controller emits userActivityLog but only logUserActivity has a listener, so those actions are not audited
GET /v2/patient/:serialNumber is unreachable (shadowed by /:patientId); /v2/transmissions is mounted twice
apiJob service hard-codes the account 'Eastside Urgent Care' (apiJob.v2.service.js:220)
A revoked-session 401 reveals whether the account is deactivated or locked to anyone holding an old signed token (EL-5580, security.md finding 16)
Account-document upload writes S3 before the DB upsert with no rollback (EL-5597)
Repository CLAUDE.md claims no lockfile is committed, but yarn.lock is tracked and used by the Dockerfile (stale claim)
